maxims: ONE ORGANISM / ONE INTELLIGENCE SUBSTRATE / ONE AUTHORITY MODEL

SELF.name: SELF
SELF.purpose: Establish who/whose mission/current continuity this cycle belongs to.
state_writes: only state owned by this responsibility through canonical substrate
SELF.authority_required: valid LAW decision for consequential action/use where applicable
SELF.privacy_behavior: preserve owner/scope; no widening without explicit authorization
fail_closed: missing or invalid authority when action requires it
receipts: existing canonical receipt/evidence surface; no node-specific shadow ledger
SELF.cold_successor_obligation: successor may recover semantic/intelligence context but never inherit authority merely from context
SELF.success_criteria: SELF performs only its owned responsibility, emits a bounded handoff, and does not assume responsibilities owned by another Node.

truth_boundary: Contract existence does not prove runtime binding. Each Node requires behavioral/production evidence.

shared_decision_calculus.law: The calculus is shared infrastructure across the nine organs; it is not a tenth node and never creates authority.

node_roles.SELF: resolve declared objective, stakeholders, baseline, horizon, and current ladder state
node_roles.LAW: apply hard gates, Prime Judgment Rule, scope, consent, authority, and risk policy before optimization
node_roles.ACT: execute only an ACT outcome that is admissible, authorized, bounded, and selected by the canonical calculus
node_roles.KNOW: supply current evidence-bound facts, estimates, prior decision receipts, and applicable retained intelligence
node_roles.PROVE: preserve scoring inputs, provenance, uncertainty, gate reasons, predicted value, and decision receipt evidence
node_roles.CONNECT: retrieve and relate applicable intelligence, dependencies, affected parties, baselines, and graph context without creating truth or authority
node_roles.VERIFY: independently recompute decision/outcome claims, compare predicted vs observed value, and preserve calibration error
node_roles.LEARN: turn verified calibration error into versioned VALUE_RECALIBRATION learning candidates; never self-ratify
node_roles.EVOLVE: promote only verified and authorized recalibration versions into successor/system continuity without changing constitutional boundaries
